create_MultivariateNormal: create a multivariate normal distribution from a mean vector and covariance matrix
create_MultivariateNormal_precision: create a multivariate normal distribution parameterized by a precision matrix
create_MultivariateNormal_scale_tril: create a multivariate normal distribution using a lower-triangular scale matrix
sample_MultivariateNormal: sample from a multivariate normal distribution using rsample with a given sample shape
compute_MultivariateNormal_log_prob: compute the log probability of a value under a multivariate normal distribution
